name: Design an accessible layout
short_description: Arrange text and images in a one-page layout that passes stated contrast, hierarchy, and reading-order checks.
self_assessment: I can design one page that passes three accessibility checks without help.
description: Arrange text and images in a one-page layout that passes stated contrast, hierarchy, and reading-order checks. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Lay out a one-page public notice

builds_on.note: Image handling supports preparing layout assets.
